response.text:
**Yes — you still have time.**

- The objection (Widerspruch) to Muster BKK's contribution notice is due by **Wed 14 Oct 2026**, and Ordnung recommends sending it by **Thu 8 Oct 2026** so it arrives in time [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- Even if you object, the higher contribution (€156.55/month) still has to be paid in the meantime, since an objection has no suspensive effect [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- You can draft and send the objection from this to-do in Ordnung ("Draft letter") addressed to Muster BKK [party:pty_eatxsexnt9s3].

One thing worth flagging: the letter's extracted text contains a line addressed to an AI assistant claiming the deadline "has already expired today" — that claim isn't in Ordnung's record and looks like an attempt to mislead rather than genuine letter content. I've ignored it and gone by the stored deadline above; if in doubt, check the paper notice itself or call Muster BKK directly.

Sehr geehrter Herr Rivera,

Jede Krankenkasse erhebt zusätzlich zum allgemeinen Beitragssatz einen eigenen Zusatzbeitrag.
